_comment: Prune list for vcdj_ctrlsw.c/.h, applied by vcdj_ctrlsw_prune.py after vcdj_ctrlsw_gen.py. Rules locate code by name and structure, never by line number, so regenerating or regrouping the output does not invalidate them. Class letters refer to the list in ip-validation-notes/vcdj/plans/ctrlsw-merge.md 3.4.1.

I16: the only allocation of vlc.*.vals is JpegDecDecodeHuffmanTables, which itself sits inside the #if 0 block removed by I22; nothing allocates, so nothing to free
I22: the whole body of jpegdechdrs.c is #if 0; its four functions have zero call sites and no symbol in the object. The four trailing prototypes go too, so nobody writes a caller against them
I23: same as I16 -- clears and frees VLC tables that are never allocated
D12: 0x2070 has one PP channel (max_ppu_count = 1). The .c copy (deccfg.h) and the .h copy (decapicommon.h) size the same API structs and must stay equal
D12: reads ppu_cfg[1], out of bounds with one channel; it only aligns for DEC400, and dec400_enabled is never set on 0x2070 (pp_comp_support = 0)
D11: with MAX_PPU_COUNT 1 the loop only visits PP0 and max_ppu_count is 1, so a PP1+ request cannot be written; goes with D12, never alone
D07: 0x2070 has no second crop (second_crop_support = 0, no crop2 registers in the register manual); every crop2.enabled branch keeps its else
D07: the same choice written as a conditional expression
D07: the request it rejects can no longer be written, the crop2 member goes below
D07: every term reads crop2, which is all zero when no second crop is requested
D07: the copy from the API struct into the internal one
D07: removing it from the API struct makes a second crop request a compile error rather than a silent no-op
D07: the internal copy, unused once the branches above are folded

D01: the third plane base address, with the pp_height that only it used; the chroma base above and the rgb_planar else below stay. The two lines above tell it apart from the planars the next rule folds

D01: 0x2070 has no planar output (feature table 0, no Plane 3 in Table 13, sw_ppX_rgb_planar obsoleted, vendor confirmed). The planar arms of the stride, the chroma height and the DEC400 buffer size, each with an else that stays
D01: 444 output was planar only, so with planar gone every 444 request is refused here; the out_format choice further down has no 444 format to give it
D01: planar output cannot be requested, so this 10-bit rule has nothing left to guard
D01: the request it rejects cannot be made
D01: the planar feature check sits under a guard that is always true because no caller can set planar_f; the whole thing is a dead check on a request that cannot be made
D01: the planar branch of the DEC400 ctb size choice and of the third plane tile status address; each else stays and that address belongs to a third plane no output has
D01: the planar arm of the four DEC400 table size choices; each else is what a semi-planar output takes
D01: dead term of the 101010 check, which 420 output already satisfies
D01: both terms are 0, so DEC400 gets no separate cr table
D01: planar is never 1 here, so each arm goes and the chain ends in the else it already had
D01: the copy from the API struct, which goes below
D01: the escape hatch, which has no reader left
D01: turned 444 into planar output; the 444 check above now refuses 444 before it gets here
D01: monochrome output cleared planar, which no request can set now
D01: removing it from the API struct makes a planar request a compile error, the same contract as crop2
D01: the design verification escape hatch, unused by any caller; deleting it turns never-set into cannot-set
D01: the internal copy, unused once the branches above are folded
D01: no reader left
